purpose: Provide the single Book-parent durable queue for unresolved AUTHOR_ONLY decisions, capture an explicit authenticated author choice against exact current subject identities, and atomically append one immutable canonical AUTHOR_DECISION plus a resolution receipt without promoting manuscript, advancing lifecycle, admitting a proposal, freezing export or authorizing publication in the same authority operation.
non_duplication_law: Reuse the existing canonical AUTHOR_DECISION object; do not create a second canonical decision model.
Reuse Runtime V2 author handoffs as one decision-request source; do not create a second proposal/admission queue.
Reuse Lifecycle Transition Engine author gates as consumers; do not create a second lifecycle engine.
Reuse Version/Rollback authorized-successor ingestion for the resulting parent successor; do not create a second state/version ledger.
Book owns queue semantics and decision evidence; System Master Core/app layer owns actual iPhone rendering and authentication/session presentation mechanics.

authority.rule: The queue captures an explicit author act and the parent transactionally records it. A service may supply options/evidence only through a registered parent boundary; no service or model may choose, approve or fabricate author authority.

decision_authority_classes.AUTHOR_ONLY: Resolved only by explicit authenticated author interaction.
decision_authority_classes.PARENT_OPERATIONAL: Must stay with the existing owning Book parent runtime and must not be routed here merely because alternatives exist.
decision_authority_classes.EXTERNAL_OR_LEGAL: May be tracked as a dependency but cannot be represented as author authority unless the same person independently holds that authority.

queue_ledger.rule: Material request-state changes create immutable request snapshots with predecessor lineage. Existing snapshots and resolution receipts are never edited or deleted in place.

rules: option_id is stable within one option_set_digest.
No option is preselected as the author's choice.
Provider/model ranking may be preserved as evidence but may not become a default selection or author authority.
Labels and effects must be plain-language and materially distinguish the options.
A custom author option is accepted only when custom_option_allowed=true and must not be silently normalized into a predefined model-preferred option.

INTEGRATION_RUNTIME_HANDOFF.dedup_rule: Equivalent current Runtime V2 handoffs may attach to one decision family while every source handoff remains preserved.

LIFECYCLE_GATE_REQUIREMENT.rule: The queue captures the decision only; Lifecycle independently revalidates and executes any transition afterward.

EDITORIAL_STAGE_REQUIREMENT.rule: Editorial evidence may explain a choice but cannot resolve it.

PARENT_DIRECT_AUTHOR_QUERY.rule: Parent-created author questions must still bind exact subject/current parent identities and cannot be generic floating prompts.

rules: All exact source identities must resolve against the bound current parent state or explicitly admitted immutable artifacts.
Unknown decision type/source authority/schema fails closed.
Equivalent replay returns the existing current queue reference without another queue commit.
A materially changed subject identity or option set creates a new request snapshot/family successor rather than mutating a presented request.
No choice is marked selected by default.
Do not hide or add friction to a valid reject/retain/defer option in order to steer acceptance.
Expose concise primary information with optional detail rather than forcing raw internal evidence into the decision surface.
Actual UI components, hit targets, VoiceOver labels and layout remain app/Core responsibilities; the Book projection must carry enough semantics to support them.
mobile_acceptance_targets: supports clear text labels for every option
supports at least 44x44 pt iOS hit regions in the renderer
supports non-scrolling compact choice presentation for small option sets and a non-action-sheet presentation for larger sets
supports explicit review/confirmation before consequential immutable commit
does not require timed interaction or auto-dismiss for author choice

confirmation_policy.rule: A confirmation requirement never means preselection; the author must first make an explicit choice and then confirm the exact selected choice/consequence when required.

rules: The author identity/authority proof must be supplied by the owning System Master identity/session boundary; the Book queue does not self-authenticate or invent the author.
The exact current parent, queue ledger and queue-item identities must match before author choice is evaluated.
PENDING or PRESENTED current items may resolve; STALE, SUPERSEDED, WITHDRAWN or already RESOLVED items cannot create a second canonical decision.
selected_option_id must resolve in the exact bound option set, or custom_author_choice must be present only when custom_option_allowed=true.
Required confirmation evidence must bind the exact selected choice and decision_request_digest.
No timeout, inactivity, model confidence or provider result may substitute for resolution_request.
The canonical object remains compatible with the already-qualified Canonical State Model.
Queue-only identity, provenance and concurrency metadata remain in queue ledger/receipt rather than silently changing the canonical object schema.
A correction or changed choice after commit creates a new decision request and new AUTHOR_DECISION; it never mutates the existing decision under the same decision_id.

precondition_order: validate resolution schema and author authority proof reference
resolve exact current decision request snapshot
validate item state/currentness and subject identities
validate exact option set and selected/custom choice
construct one canonical AUTHOR_DECISION using existing schema
construct a parent successor that appends only that AUTHOR_DECISION
validate no other canonical pointer/project status/proposal/export mutation occurred
commit parent successor plus resolved queue snapshot plus resolution receipt atomically or expose none
emit authority receipt for Version/Rollback authorized-successor ingestion
resolution_transaction.failure_rule: Any failed precondition leaves parent state and queue ledger unchanged and emits no successful author-decision receipt.

material_staleness_triggers: option set or material consequences changed
rules: A stale presented item remains historical and cannot resolve.
Revalidation that changes material decision meaning creates a successor request snapshot and, when necessary, a new decision family version.
A previously committed AUTHOR_DECISION remains immutable history but consumers must independently test whether it is current/applicable to their exact subject before acting.
Withdrawal or supersession never deletes the old request, presentation or decision evidence.

defer_reopen_withdraw.defer: Creates a DEFERRED queue snapshot; it does not create canonical AUTHOR_DECISION or approval.
defer_reopen_withdraw.reopen: Creates a new current PENDING/PRESENTED snapshot after currentness revalidation; prior DEFERRED snapshot remains immutable.
defer_reopen_withdraw.withdraw: Creates WITHDRAWN only under parent source authority when the underlying requirement legitimately no longer applies; author choice is not fabricated.
defer_reopen_withdraw.supersede: Creates SUPERSEDED when a replacement request/current subject makes the old request inapplicable.

concurrency_idempotency_and_dedup.write_identity: parent_state_version + parent_state_digest + queue_ledger_version + queue_ledger_digest + decision_request_version + decision_request_digest
concurrency_idempotency_and_dedup.duplicate_handoff_rule: Coalesce only semantically equivalent current requests while retaining every source_handoff_ref; do not coalesce requests with different subject digests, decision types, option-set digests or authority classes.

consumer_boundary.lifecycle: Consumes exact APPROVED/type/applicable AUTHOR_DECISION refs under its existing qualified gate; queue cannot invoke transition authority implicitly.
consumer_boundary.integration_runtime: May observe decision refs/currentness for proposal eligibility; queue cannot admit proposal implicitly.
consumer_boundary.version_and_rollback: Records the already-committed author-decision parent successor using authority_kind AUTHOR_DECISION and exact authority receipt identity; it cannot reinterpret the choice.
consumer_boundary.export_publication: May consume PUBLICATION_AUTHORIZATION only after independently verifying exact current release/artifact identity; queue cannot publish.

provenance_and_privacy.external_projection: Optional W3C PROV-compatible projection may represent decision entity/activity/author agent attribution, but internal Book ledger remains canonical authority.
provenance_and_privacy.privacy_rule: Store references/minimum necessary summaries rather than copying private manuscript/evaluator/research content into queue or external provenance solely for presentation.

qualification_objective: Prove multi-source enqueue, exact subject/option/parent binding, dedup and replay, no provider/model resolution, no default author choice, presentation semantics, defer/reopen/withdraw/supersede, stale subject and stale option rejection, concurrent resolution conflict, explicit author-authority proof requirement, consequential confirmation, immutable canonical AUTHOR_DECISION append, one-decision-per-request-version, atomic parent+queue receipts, Version/Rollback authority handoff identity, consumer separation, append-only history and zero lifecycle/manuscript/proposal/export/publication mutation on the same authority transaction.
qualification_effect: NONE until an executable implementation and deterministic adversarial fixtures pass a registered exact-SHA qualification.
